newsitem.title: USA: Telebit to settle class action suit.
newsitem.headline: Telebit to settle class action suit.

text.p: Modem manufacturer Telebit Corp. said Monday it has agreed to settle a class action suit brought against the company in 1995 by shareholders for $2 million.

The company said in a statement it had reached an agreement-in-principle to settle the case against it and several company officers. The company will pay $200,000 in cash to shareholders and the remainder of the $2 million settlement will be paid by insurance.
The plaintiffs had initially estimated damages to be over $20 million, Telebit said.
The modem maker said it decided to settle to avoid further legal expenses.

"While Telebit continues to deny each of the plaintiffs' claims in their entirety, settlement at this stage and in this amount clearly is in the company's best interests," Chief Financial Officer Brian Cohen said in a statement.
Certain shareholders who bought Telebit stock alleged violations of the federal securities law in the litigation, the company said.
The settlement must be approved by the federal district court in Boston, Mass., it said.
Telebit stock was up about 15 cents at $13.125 a share in midday trading on the Nasdaq.
